deposit.note: Receive-only deposit address for USDC on Solana. Address configured 2026-11-20 from the ATLAS Solana wallet build (public address only; the keypair lives in config/wallet/ under mode 0600 and is never read, printed, or logged by the trading engine). No signing capability is stored or handled anywhere in ATLAS.

funding_rule: Eligible capital = realized net mining profits + confirmed USDC deposits on Solana only. Paper accounts are virtual-only and never draw on eligible capital.
